tools.name: court_leaderboard
tools.description: Live ranking of decision models by Brier score on resolved real-world questions. Free. Returns empty lists when nothing has resolved.

tools.name: court_model_report
tools.description: Calibration report for one model: Brier, ECE, reliability bins with Wilson intervals, overconfidence, drift. Free.

tools.name: court_verify_ledger
tools.description: Recompute the SHA-256 hash chain and cross-check derived tables. Free.

tools.name: court_recalibrate
tools.description: Paid (x402: USDC on Base, USDC on Solana, XRP on XRPL, USDC on Arc, or XAH on Xahau). Map a model's raw probability to an empirically calibrated one using resolved outcomes on the ledger. Refuses with insufficient_data below 30 samples.

tools.name: court_calibrate_labels
tools.description: Paid (x402: USDC on Base, USDC on Solana, XRP on XRPL, USDC on Arc, or XAH on Xahau). Fit isotonic calibration on YOUR labelled outcomes ({p,y} pairs) and recalibrate the given probabilities. Stateless; nothing is stored.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "court_recalibrate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Paid (x402, USDC on Base). Map a model's raw probability to an empirically calibrated one using resolved outcomes on the ledger. Refuses with insufficient_data below 30 samples." → after: "Paid (x402: USDC on Base, USDC on Solana, XRP on XRPL, USDC on Arc, or XAH on Xahau). Map a model's raw probability to an empirically calibrated one using resolved outcomes on the ledger. Refuses with insufficient_data below 30 samples."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
